item.title: Coupled dynamical Boltzmann transport equations with long-range electron-phonon and electron-electron interactions in two-dimensional materials
item.description:
The intrinsic resistivity of materials depends on the interplay of current-carrying electrons with vibrational and electronic excitations. Here, the authors develop a numerical solution to the coupled dynamics of electrons and electrodynamic modes, for 2D monolayers and heterostructures, which includes both types of excitations. They show that while resistivity is ultimately driven by phonons, electronic excitations can play a significant role via direct electron-electron scattering and dynamical screening of the phonons. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 245419] Published Fri Oct 23, 2026

item.title: Magnetic symmetry implications of the zero- and applied-field Hall effect of ${\mathrm{UNi}}_{4}\mathrm{B}$
item.description:
The authors report here two finite zero-field Hall resistivity tensor components associated with the debated magnetic ground state of the noncollinear antiferromagnet UNi4B. For a commensurate magnetic structure, the finite Hall resistivity components cannot be explained by the formation of magnetic domains but are compatible with a monoclinic magnetic symmetry lower than that of previously proposed magnetic ordering models. Additional field-dependent Hall resistivity data collected up to 16 T suggest a notable intrinsic contribution to the anomalous Hall effect. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 214426] Published Fri Oct 23, 2026
